# Architecture principles

This repository follows the universal principles of [code-architecture-principles](https://github.com/link-foundation/code-architecture-principles) (pinned at `f8a3d6ce6312`, R1188-U2).
Each principle below says how it is applied here, which CI gate fails a pull request that breaks it, and which requirement row tracks what is still missing.
A principle with neither a gate nor a gap is a convention the repository follows without a gate yet.

## Review checklist

Before asking for review, check the change against each group below: the gates run in CI, and the gaps name what a reviewer still checks by hand.

## Structure & Modularity

| Principle | How this repository applies it | Enforced by | Still missing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Modularity | Files stay small: at most 1500 lines, Rust at most 1000, worker shards under recorded line budgets, and no packed one-line code. | [`check-file-size`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-file-size.lino), [`check-worker-line-budget`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-worker-line-budget.lino), [`check-readable-code`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-readable-code.lino) | — |
| Separation of Concerns | Behaviour lives in seed data, mechanisms in code, presentation in the web UI; the compiled core stays minimal and the UI holds no solver logic. | [`check-minimal-core-boundary`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-minimal-core-boundary.lino), [`check-web-hardcoded-ui`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-web-hardcoded-ui.lino) | — |
| High Cohesion | A module owns one capability (one handler, one planner route family, one seed category file); split files are named by what they hold. | — | R1188-U5 |
| Low Coupling | Handlers meet only through the precedence table and the seed registry, never by calling each other directly. | [`check-worker-handler-registry`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-worker-handler-registry.lino), [`check-seed-registry`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-seed-registry.lino) | — |
| Composition Over Complexity | Answers are composed from small rules: seed handler rules, substitution passes and the recursive meta reasoner, instead of one large function per request shape. | [`check-debt-ratchet`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-debt-ratchet.lino) | — |
| Layers / Tiered Architecture | Surfaces (web, CLI, server, Telegram, agent CLI) sit over one solver, which sits over the seed and the links memory; dependencies point inward. | [`check-dependency-direction`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-dependency-direction.lino) | — |
| Hexagonal / Ports and Adapters | The agentic planner talks to a host port (js/agentic/host.mjs); the browser worker, the Node server and native Rust are adapters behind it. | [`check-dependency-direction`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-dependency-direction.lino) | — |
| Clean Architecture Dependency Rule | Reasoning code never names a network, file system or UI framework; it reads them through the host and the source cache. | [`check-minimal-core-boundary`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-minimal-core-boundary.lino) | — |

## Behavior, Interfaces & Abstraction

| Principle | How this repository applies it | Enforced by | Still missing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Abstraction | A capability is reached by its meaning (a seed role), not by the words of one language or one prompt. | [`check-hardcoded-language`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-hardcoded-language.lino) | R1188-U1 |
| Stable Contracts | The OpenAI-compatible server protocol, the links notation formats and the generated ledgers are versioned contracts with --check generators. | [`check-requirement-status`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-requirement-status.lino), [`check-status-render`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-status-render.lino) | — |
| Explicit Interfaces | Every JavaScript module and its Rust twin cite each other, so the shared surface is named in both roots. | [`check-twin-citations`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-twin-citations.lino), [`check-planner-twins`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-planner-twins.lino) | R1188-U16 |
| Principle of Least Surprise | Formal AI as a coding agent takes no action it was not asked for: quoted payloads are data, unpaired quotes are declined, a line edit never becomes a whole-file write. | — | R1188-U17 |
| Clear Naming | Names are full English words; files and directories say what they hold. | — | R1188-U4, R1188-U5 |
| Extensible Public Surface | New behaviour is added as seed data (a meaning, a response row, a handler rule) without changing the compiled surface. | [`check-seed-registry`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-seed-registry.lino) | — |
| Small Public Documentation | ARCHITECTURE.md is a table of contents; each topic lives in one file under docs/architecture/. | — | — |
| Intent-Revealing Interfaces | Tests read as documentation of the behaviour they pin, named by the requirement they cover. | [`check-tests-as-docs`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-tests-as-docs.lino) | — |
| Protected Variations | Language differences are confined to seed lexemes and response rows; code reads roles, so adding a language changes data only. | [`check-language-parity`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-language-parity.lino), [`check-response-parity-debt`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-response-parity-debt.lino) | — |

## State & Data

| Principle | How this repository applies it | Enforced by | Still missing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Prefer Immutability | Memory is append-only: events, learned facts and dreaming results are added, never rewritten. | — | — |
| Controlled Mutability | Mutating actions (file writes, shell commands, GitHub writes) pass the mutating-action ladder and are refused unless explicitly allowed. | [`repository-workspace-protocol`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/repository-workspace-protocol.lino) | — |
| Single Source of Truth | Seed files are listed once in data/meta/seed-registry.lino; generated ledgers and documents are rendered from one source with --check; seed mirrors are byte copies. | [`check-seed-registry`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-seed-registry.lino), [`check-seed-registry-js-twin`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-seed-registry-js-twin.lino), [`check-requirement-status`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-requirement-status.lino) | — |
| Clear State Transitions | Requirement verdicts, handler migrations and ratchets move one way: a ceiling may only fall and a floor only rise. | [`check-debt-ratchet`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-debt-ratchet.lino), [`check-coverage-ratchet`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-coverage-ratchet.lino) | — |
| Make Invalid States Impossible | Every role and response intent resolves to an authored definition, so a dangling reference cannot be merged. | [`check-closure-audit`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-closure-audit.lino), [`check-semantic-grounding`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-semantic-grounding.lino) | — |

## Side Effects, I/O & Boundaries

| Principle | How this repository applies it | Enforced by | Still missing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keep Side Effects at the Edges | The solver is a pure function of the prompt, the history and the seed; network and disk access happen in the host and the source cache. | [`check-minimal-core-boundary`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-minimal-core-boundary.lino) | — |
| Functional Core, Imperative Shell | The agentic planner returns the next tool call as data; the driver or the agent CLI performs it. | [`repository-workspace-protocol`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/repository-workspace-protocol.lino) | — |
| Explicit Side Effects | Every executed command is recorded with its argv, exit status and output hash, and answers cite that evidence. | — | — |
| Idempotence | Generators and substitution passes produce the same bytes on a second run; --check modes prove it. | [`check-status-render`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-status-render.lino), [`check-generated-files`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-generated-files.lino) | R1188-U8 |
| Stateless Processes (Where Possible) | Server requests carry their history; the worker and the Node server keep no per-request state outside memory events. | — | — |

| Validation at Boundaries | Prompts, tool results and fetched pages are parsed at the surface; quoted payloads are data and never choose a route. | — | R1188-U17 |

| Principle | How this repository applies it | Enforced by | Still missing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ubiquitous Language | Code, seed and documents use the architect's terms (links, meanings, formalization, associative memory), recorded in docs/architect-notes/. | [`check-associative-terminology`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-associative-terminology.lino) | — |
| Domain-Centered Design | The domain is meaning: concepts carry Wikidata ids, and every language reaches the same meaning. | [`check-semantic-grounding`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-semantic-grounding.lino) | — |
| Bounded Contexts | Capabilities are separate contexts (calculation, translation, coding, research), each with its own seed category files and routing row. | [`check-capability-routing`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-capability-routing.lino) | — |
| Value Objects | Quantities, units, dates and identifiers are values compared by content, as links in the notation. | — | — |
| Aggregates / Consistency Boundaries | A conversation, a memory export and a repository workspace are each written and restored as one consistent document. | — | — |

## Simplicity, Clarity & Maintenance

| Principle | How this repository applies it | Enforced by | Still missing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Simplicity Over Cleverness | A failing prompt is fixed by the smallest more universal rule, never by a case for that prompt. | [`check-hardcoded-language`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-hardcoded-language.lino), [`check-prompt-specialization`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-prompt-specialization.lino) | R1188-U1 |
| Self-documented Code | Doc comments say why; names are full words; generated files say which command regenerates them. | [`check-rust-api-documentation`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-rust-api-documentation.lino) | R1188-U4 |
| Minimize Cognitive Load | Code is readable multi-line text and links notation stays human readable and deduplicated. | [`check-readable-code`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-readable-code.lino) | R1188-U6, R1188-U7 |
| Minimize nesting | Early returns and small helpers; clippy's cognitive-complexity lints run with warnings denied. | [`run-clippy`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/run-clippy.lino) | — |
| Small Units | Small files, small functions and small CI steps: no job over 30 minutes. | [`check-file-size`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-file-size.lino), [`check-ci-speed`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-ci-speed.lino) | — |
| Continuous refactoring | Debt is measured and ratcheted down on every pull request rather than scheduled for later. | [`check-debt-ratchet`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-debt-ratchet.lino), [`check-worker-line-budget`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-worker-line-budget.lino) | — |
| The Unix “Do One Thing Well” Principle | Each script does one job (assemble, generate, render, check) and each CI gate checks one rule. | [`check-ci-gate-registry`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/check-ci-gate-registry.lino) | — |
| Programs Should Work Together | Every surface speaks plain text and links notation; the server is OpenAI compatible, so any agent CLI drives Formal AI. | [`repository-workspace-protocol`](../../data/meta/ci-gates/repository-workspace-protocol.lino) | — |
